title: Northgate Optical Switch-Down Refit Fee Schedule
content:
| Days from the dispensed date to the opening of the latest non-adapt remake | Switch-down refit fee |
|---|---|
| 0 to 30 | none |
| 31 to 60 | 7.50 |

**Northgate Optical switch-down refit fee.** Where the latest non-adapt remake was opened no more than 30 days after the dispensed date, no switch-down refit fee is deducted, and where it was opened 31 to 60 days after the dispensed date, the refit fee is 7.50. A remake opened more than 60 days after the dispensed date is outside this schedule.

**Counting the days.** Days are calendar days from the dispensed date of the eyewear job, which is day 0, to the opening date of the latest non-adapt remake — the date of the latest remake charge entry on the job carrying the non-adapt reason. The dispensed date is the date of first dispensing and does not move with a remake.

### Boundary illustrations (hypothetical dates, dispensed 1 March 2025)

| Latest non-adapt remake opened | Day | Refit fee under the schedule |
|---|---|---|
| 31 March 2025 | 30 | none |
| 1 April 2025 | 31 | 7.50 |
| 30 April 2025 | 60 | 7.50 |
| 1 May 2025 | 61 | outside the schedule |

Only the latest non-adapt remake is counted: where a job has had two non-adapt remakes, the days run to the opening date of the second.
